assessment.a_redistributing_exported_game_logs: Game logs are OUTPUTS of running the CC BY-NC-licensed checkpoints (Licensed Material). The license text governs reproduction/Sharing of the Licensed Material and of Adapted Material ('derived from or based upon the Licensed Material ... modified in a manner requiring permission under the Copyright and Similar Rights'). Whether machine-generated action logs are 'Adapted Material' is not settled by the text; a raw sequence of game moves is unlikely to carry the checkpoints' copyright at all (Sec. 8a: the license does not restrict uses that need no permission). CONSERVATIVE reading: treat the logs as Adapted Material -> they may be Shared for NonCommercial purposes only (2a1b), with attribution (3a1), an indication that they were produced with/derived from the OBL checkpoints, and an Adapter's License that does not prevent recipients from complying with CC BY-NC (3a4) — i.e. release the logs under CC BY-NC 4.0 (or a NonCommercial-compatible license), not under MIT/CC0/CC BY. Under either reading, redistribution of the logs is PERMITTED for a non-commercial research release with attribution; what is NOT permitted is a commercial-use grant.
assessment.b_derived_json_results: Aggregate statistics (gap_results.json, gap_interlevel.json, per-category tables) are facts about the logs, further removed from the checkpoints than the logs themselves; they are not reproductions of the Licensed Material and almost certainly not Adapted Material. Nothing in CC BY-NC 4.0 restricts them (Sec. 8a). Redistribution under the paper's own license is permitted; attribution to Hu et al. 2021 / facebookresearch/off-belief-learning is required by scholarly norm and is prudent under 3a if the JSON is regarded as derived from the checkpoints.
assessment.c_attribution_requirements: If anything derived from the checkpoints is Shared, Sec. 3(a)(1) requires: (i) identification of the creator ('Facebook, Inc. and its affiliates', per the repo copyright notice) and a copyright notice; (ii) a notice referring to CC BY-NC 4.0 and to its disclaimer of warranties; (iii) a URI to the Licensed Material (github.com/facebookresearch/off-belief-learning and/or the model zip URL); (iv) an indication that the material was modified/derived (e.g. 'game logs generated by running the released icml_OBL* checkpoints in the OBL/HLE environment'); (v) the text of, or a link to, the license. 3(a)(2): any reasonable manner appropriate to the medium suffices (a data-card / README line with the URI). 2(a)(6): do not imply endorsement by Facebook/Meta. Do NOT redistribute the checkpoints themselves under a non-NC license; pointing to the official download is the safe route.
assessment.bottom_line: Redistribute: derived JSON results (yes, any license, with citation) and exported game logs (yes, for NonCommercial purposes, under CC BY-NC 4.0 or compatible, with the 3(a) attribution block). Do not redistribute the checkpoints; link to the official zip. This is a reading of the license text, not legal advice.
